messages:
Emma (CS): Heads-up — Quellix onboarding metrics: token spend above forecast and a sporadic p95 spike. Renewal in 3 weeks, they want cost wins. Proposal: staged int8 quant for background traffic + hybrid routing split realtime vs batch. Anyone object? 

Leo (ML Eng): Sounds good. int8 on redwood-open-7b-v2 should drop cost ~25-30%. Need to validate quality on their 500 prompt eval set. Canary rollout recommended: 5% -> 20% -> 100% if quality within threshold. Also consider prefix caching for templated prompts to cut tokens. 

Sam (SRE): Routing plan: keep realtime short prompts on low-latency pool, push long/batch to quantized pool. That preserves UX while shifting cost. I can push a policy. 

Sam (SRE): Policy example:
```yaml
routes:
  - match: "realtime == true and prompt_len < 512"
    pool: "gpu-low-latency"
    weight: 90
  - match: "default"
    pool: "quantized-cost"
    weight: 10
canary:
  percent: 5
  duration: 1h
monitor:
  metrics: ["cost_per_token", "p95_latency", "quality_delta"]
  alerts:
    - condition: "quality_delta > 2%"
      action: rollback
    - condition: "p95_latency > 850ms"
      action: notify
``` 

Andre (Solutions): Customer target is 20% cost reduction; they accept minor fidelity loss for non-interactive flows. I'll draft a summary for renewal and include fallback behavior. 

Quellix Admin: Uploaded the 500 prompts CSV to shared drive. We'll be on-call for the canary window. 

OpsBot: Canary scheduled (canary-id cq-2955550000). Auto-monitoring enabled. Alerts: quality_delta > 2%, p95_latency > 850ms. 

Emma (CS): Action items: 1) Leo runs eval on the 500 prompts (T+1d). 2) Sam deploys routing + canary (T+2d). 3) Andre prepares customer-facing savings memo (T+2d). I'll prep renewal note. Thanks :thumbsup: 

Leo (ML Eng): Running eval now, will post results here by EOD tomorrow. If quality delta is borderline we can tighten canary and enable auto-rollforward thresholds. 

Quellix Admin: Appreciate it — main usage between 09:00-17:00 PST, so canary outside peak preferred. We'll coordinate windows.
